Icon proposals · round 2

Four hand-made directions for the launcher icon and favicon, each from a real craft. Every line is a tapered stroke or a hand-cut shape with a slow wobble, not a circle-and-rectangle kit. Each has a 16/32 px cut that keeps the same mark with the texture dropped. Folders hold icon.svg, foreground.svg (adaptive, 108 canvas, art inside the 66 safe circle), background.txt, monochrome.svg and favicon.svg. Proposals only; nothing is wired in. Built by round2/build.mjs.

Linocut trout

Two-block linocutround2/1-linocut-trout/

A rainbow trout cut in lino: one ink block with V-gouge marks for gill, scales and tail rays, and a second coral block for the rainbow band. The 16 px cut drops the gouges and keeps fish + band + eye.

Scratchboard dry fly

Scratchboard / penround2/2-scratchboard-fly/

A hand-tied dry fly scratched out of a black board: hackle fibres one by one, upright split wings, a rust dubbed body on the hook. The 16 px cut turns the hackle into one jagged disc.

Enamel sockeye badge

Cloisonné enamel pinround2/3-enamel-sockeye/

A spawning sockeye (red body, green hooked head) leaping, set in brass wire on park-green enamel inside a hand-bent double rim, like a club or licence pin. 16 px drops rim and water.

Stamped ? float

Rubber stamp / brush letterround2/4-stamp-question/
